verdict.rationale: LangGraph is itself an official, installable Python library (`pip install -U langgraph`) with documented programmatic APIs such as stream/astream and first-party checkpoint packages, so developers clearly build against first-party code. The evidence shows only the Python framework, not a broader set of official SDKs. missing for 10: evidence of multiple language SDKs (e.g., JS/TS), an official client SDK for the Agent Server API, SDK reference docs, and independent corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: LangGraph graphs expose the stream (sync) and astream (async) methods to yield streamed outputs as iterators.
LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for building, managing, and deploying long-running, stateful agents.
